title: ChangesResult, QueryResult, AddedItem, QueryChangesResult missing #[non_exhaustive]
description: backend.rs lines 198-245: four public structs are missing #[non_exhaustive]. BackendChangesError and BackendSetError correctly have it. Adding a field to ChangesResult (e.g., 'immutable_properties' for Mailbox optimizations) breaks all downstream code that constructs it, since struct literal construction of non-exhaustive types is a compile error for external crates. This is a breaking API surface that fossilizes on first publish. Fix: add #[non_exhaustive] to ChangesResult, QueryResult, AddedItem, QueryChangesResult. Impact: backends must construct via ..Default::default() or a constructor; add constructors if missing.
